alt: Experiment 2: mean true Sharpe ratio of the plug-in portfolio against the sample's length in years of sessions, log scale. With means and covariances estimated it rises from 0.230 at 0.52 years to 0.816 at 33.2, about equal to equal weights' 0.327 at 1.04 years; with the covariances alone it is 0.8660 already at 0.52 years, near the best 0.880
